sections.summary: Summarizes stationary and integrated time-series models, notes that many economic levels are near random walks, sets up the null hypothesis in regression, and shows analytically why R2 between independent autocorrelated series can be misleadingly large.

sections.summary: Reports simulations of regressions among independent random walks and other autocorrelated processes, showing severely inflated rejection rates and high average R2 as the number of explanatory series increases.
sections.title: Simulation evidence on spurious regressions
